body:
## Why
121 assertion sites in 21 test files read the fake GitHub's internals (`gh.calls` 52, `lockRefs()` 26, `runOf()` 43 — `docs/local-first.md` §11). Nothing under `src/store/github.js` can be deleted before they move (§10, track C).

## What
1. `test/fake-store.js`: an in-memory implementation of the `Store` interface (§6.4) with the fixture helpers the suite uses today (`kbIssue`, `runWith`, `statusOf`, `runOf`, `locks()`, `calls`), installable through `openStore`'s injection point (add one to `src/store/index.js` if A3 did not: `setStore(fn)` returning a restore function, like `setTransport`).
2. Rewrite the assertion sites: `gh.calls` → `store.calls` (the method names, not REST paths); `lockRefs()` → `store.locks()`; `runOf()` unchanged in meaning. Keep `test/fake-gh.js` for the forge half and for `test/store.test.js`'s GitHub driver only.
3. Run every rewritten scenario against the local driver too where it is board behaviour (a temp repo per file is acceptable; keep the run under two minutes).

## Done when
- [ ] `grep -rn "gh\.calls\|lockRefs()" test | grep -v fake-gh.js | grep -v store.test.js` returns nothing.
- [ ] `npm test` green in under three minutes on this machine.

## Contract
Test-only card: nothing under `src/` changes except the injection point named above, if missing.

**Read first:** `docs/local-first.md` (the plan; the sections named below), `docs/wiki/decisions/adr-005-control-plane.md`,
`docs/wiki/decisions/adr-006-local-store.md`, `CLAUDE.md`. Keep it dependency-free at runtime. Pure logic in
`src/model.js` with a test. Errors name the fix and carry `.exitCode`. `--json` everywhere. Update the wiki page a
change touches (`node .repolore/scripts/wiki-check.mjs` lists what went stale); a new feature gets a new page.
Finish with `npm run lint && npm test` green, one draft PR, and exactly one terminal verb.
goal: test/fake-store.js exists; every test that asserted on fake-gh internals asserts on the store double instead; the same scenarios run against the local driver; npm test green
title: Tests onto a store double: the assertion sites that read gh.calls, lockRefs() and runOf()
